name: msentity-spectrum-viewer
description: View msentity datasets (MSDS, MSP, MGF, TSV, CSV) and similarity results (.mssim) in VS Code, powered by the msentity C++ library.

commands.title: MS Entity: Show Spectrum Viewer Logs

msentitySpectrumViewer.backendPath.description: Path of a msentity-viewer-backend executable to use instead of the one included in the extension (for development builds).

msentitySpectrumViewer.pageSize.description: Number of spectra loaded per page.

msentitySpectrumViewer.loading.allowDupl.description: Combine duplicate MSP/MGF metadata fields instead of discarding the record. One non-empty value is unchanged; multiple values are stored as always-quoted CSV fields.

msentitySpectrumViewer.loading.canonical.description: Canonicalize MSP/MGF column names while loading (for example PRECURSORMZ to PrecursorMZ).
Canonicalize MSP/MGF adduct values while loading (for example [M+H]1+ to [M+H]+).

msentitySpectrumViewer.loading.normalize.description: Normalize each MSP/MGF spectrum so its base peak has intensity 1.

msentitySpectrumViewer.loading.specIdPre.description: Optional prefix used to assign sequential SpecID values while loading.

msentitySpectrumViewer.loading.inferType.description: Infer numeric TSV/CSV column types while loading.

msentitySpectrumViewer.loading.errorLogL.description: Error logging level for skipped MSP/MGF records. The default 'none' writes no log.

msentitySpectrumViewer.loading.errorLogF.description: Optional path for the MSP/MGF error log. No log is written when the error log level is 'none'.

enumDescriptions: Normalize all peaks in both spectra
Ignore unmatched query peaks in the query norm

msentitySpectrumViewer.similarity.thresh.description: Default score threshold of a library search: only matches at or above it are saved.

msentitySpectrumViewer.similarity.mzTole.description: Default m/z tolerance in Da: two peaks match when |m/z1 − m/z2| is at most this value. 0 turns the Da rule off (ppm only).
Default m/z tolerance in ppm of the mean m/z of the two peaks. Peaks match when either the Da or the ppm rule holds; 0 turns the ppm rule off (Da only).

msentitySpectrumViewer.similarity.intens.description: Default intensity exponent: intensities are raised to this power before scoring (0.5 = square root).

msentitySpectrumViewer.similarity.includ.description: Store the matched spectra and their metadata in the result by default (otherwise a lightweight result with indices and scores only).

msentitySpectrumViewer.similarity.thread.description: Worker threads of a similarity calculation; 0 uses all hardware threads.

enumDescriptions: Modified dot product (also matches precursor-shifted peaks)
msentitySpectrumViewer.spectrumCompariso.description: Initial score method when two spectra are compared in the Mass Spectrum view.
Initial fragment matching tolerance (± Da) when two spectra are compared in the Mass Spectrum view.

msentitySpectrumViewer.spectrumFloatingW.description: Open the reusable Mass Spectrum editor in a separate VS Code floating window. If disabled, it opens beside the dataset table.

msentitySpectrumViewer.structureSmilesCo.description: Preferred metadata column containing SMILES for Structure previews. Matching is case-insensitive; known SMILES column names are used as fallbacks when this column is absent.

msentitySpectrumViewer.showStructureColu.description: Show the Structure column when a SMILES column exists. Structures are drawn by RDKit, which is included in the extension.

msentitySpectrumViewer.structurePreviewW.description: Width in pixels used to render Structure preview SVGs.

msentitySpectrumViewer.structurePreviewH.description: Height in pixels used to render Structure preview SVGs.
